reason: The lab report on the page is more than most brands give me, but I don't take magnesium because no doctor has told me to. I'm not going to start a daily supplement off a TikTok Shop listing.
objection: Nothing here tells me I actually need magnesium. A tested batch only proves the capsule contains what the box says, not that it does anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor recommending magnesium, or a blood test showing I'm low. Then I'd look at the lab report and probably try one box at the launch price.
